resources.string: Watches for the official Reddit app and hides NSFW posts behind a shield overlay while Reddit is in the foreground. For safety, this service removes itself from the enabled accessibility services the instant any other app — including banking apps — appears, so it never runs over anything except Reddit.
Checks only Android Settings screens for attempts to modify or remove DNS Guard. Shows a PIN challenge or goes back on destructive actions. This is optional and independent of the Reddit shield.
